May – AED 5,500
June – AED 5,500
July – AED 5,500
August – AED 6,000
September – AED 6,500
October – AED 7,000

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is also applicable.

For a 6-month booking, the payment structure will be as follows: first month rent, last month rent, and the security deposit upfront, with the remaining months payable monthly (30 nights per month).

Kindly let us know if you would like to proceed with the booking or if you would prefer to arrange an in-person viewing. We will be happy to assist you further.
